Kaṭakarājavaṃśāvalī

Kaṭandī
a. old bhāṣya on the Vaiśeṣika sūtras ascribed to Rāvaṇa, known from citations: Anargharāghava of Murāri, K.

edn. p. 235; BrahmasūtraPrakaṭārthavivaraṇa, Mad. Uni. edn. I. p. 491; Padmanābha's Kiraṇāvalī-bhāskara, C. on the Maṅgalaśloka; Mallavādin's Dvādaśāranayacakra (Ch.. 6, 7); Siṁhasūri's Nyāyānugamānusāriṇī, C. on the above.
See S. Kuppuswami Sastri, Rāvaṇabhāṣya, JOR. Madras, III. p.. 1-5; Vaiśeṣikasūtra with Candrānanda's C. GOS. CXXXVI, Skt. Intro. p.. 6-7, Eng. Intro. p.. 10-13 an. App. VI. p.. 147-51.

Kaṭila,_Kaṭilla

Kaṭukarāja
of Bhillamālā family, father of Āsaḍa (Vivekamañjarī, Upadeśakandalī etc.). Peters. III. p. 101 (no. 260). See NCC. II. p. 230a.

Kāṭayavema
Vema, son of Kāṭaya; minister an. sister's husband of the Reddi King Kumāragiri Vasantarāja of Koṇḍavīḍu, 1386-1402 A. D.; was bestowed sovereignty over Rājamahendrapura; died

-8 A. D. Intro. verses in his C. on the Abhijñānaśākuntala refer to his military exploits. All his C.s on the three plays of Kālidāsa bear his brother-in-law's name.
--C. Kumāragirirājīya on Abhijñānaśākuntala.
